cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

mechanism: A downplays a possible move while assigning B availability and interpreting each response as a judgment of personal loyalty.
confusable: Not merely arranging help: there is no flat yet, and A grades B devotion while treating B Friday as schedulable.
comparison: Poster order and past favors versus hypothetical move and phone availability.
seedUse: D11 Friday/move/Alex paint/phone/no flat/battery; S06 modest request becomes schedule.
